categories.main_business_segments: Funshine Culture Group primarily operates in large-scale cultural performance event creation, design, and production services; cultural tourism performance creation, design, and production; landscape artistic lighting and performance creative design and production; virtual performance product creation and production; and C-end (consumer) operation projects. The company focuses on national-level major events, cultural tourism performances, and immersive digital experiences.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates advanced cultural technologies such as AR (Augmented Reality), VR (Virtual Reality), AI (Artificial Intelligence), holographic projection, 3D visual effects, drone light shows, and digital twin technologies into its creative and production processes. It emphasizes 'culture + technology' fusion, employing proprietary stage machinery, movable stage systems, and interactive lighting design to enhance artistic expression and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government bodies commissioning national-level cultural and sports events, tourism enterprises requiring cultural tourism performances, and commercial clients for large-scale entertainment productions. The company also serves end consumers through immersive cultural tourism projects and virtual entertainment platforms, targeting cultural and tourism sectors, event organizers, and urban development projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Funshine Culture Group operates mainly in China, with significant business in the East China region, including Shanghai, Zhejiang, and Shandong provinces. It also has presence in North China, South China, Northeast, Northwest, Central, and Southwest regions. The company has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and engages in projects across multiple Chinese provinces and cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cultural and entertainment supply chain, focusing on creative design, production, and event execution services. It integrates upstream technology development and equipment manufacturing through strategic investments but mainly delivers end-to-end cultural event solutions and content production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 'culture + technology' integration, enhancing digital and immersive experience capabilities, and expanding virtual performance products. R&D focuses on developing innovative stage equipment such as mobile stage systems, tilt-swing platforms, and cross-track movable stage systems, alongside AI-driven content creation and digital human technologies. The company aims to lead in cultural technology innovation and expand its IP and digital content ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through professional design and production service contracts for cultural performances and events, cultural tourism performance operations, and related creative services. The company also earns from virtual entertainment products and C-end consumer projects. Income is primarily from project-based service fees, with no significant reliance on product sales or licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Funshine Culture Group is positioned as a leading high-end cultural creative enterprise in China, recognized for its strong creative design capabilities, extensive experience in major national projects, and brand influence. The industry features fragmented competition with many low-end players; however, Funshine holds a competitive advantage in the premium segment due to its innovation, project execution quality, and integrated service model.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 579 million, a 14.42% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 41.77 million, down 68.94%. Despite revenue decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company manages assets totaling around RMB 3.67 billion and maintains a solid equity base. It is actively expanding C-end business and pursuing strategic acquisitions to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Funshine Culture Group differentiates itself through its unique integration of cultural creativity and cutting-edge technology, delivering immersive, high-quality cultural performances and digital experiences. Its full-process service model—from creative conception to production and post-event operation—ensures tailored, innovative solutions that resonate culturally and technologically. The company’s strong brand, experienced creative teams, and technological leadership provide clients with distinctive, impactful cultural event experiences.
